newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: U.N. team finds Zaire refugee camp empty -- UNHCR.
newsitem.headline: U.N. team finds Zaire refugee camp empty -- UNHCR.

text.p: A United Nations team in Zaire has found camps near rebel-held Kisangani empty of the some 50,000 Rwandan Hutu refugees who were there last week, a spokeswoman said on Thursday.

Pam O'Toole of the UNHCR refugee agency said the team, allowed to go to the Kasese area by the rebels earlier in the day, had radioed back that they had found no one. "It appears the camps are empty," she added.

Rebels agreed to allow the U.N. mission to the camps after U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan said he was "shocked and appalled by the inhumanity" of their action which he said was killing refugees by starvation.
